body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. Ignore its cover bonus if no other enemy is adjacent to you.

surges.html: On a hit, shift 1 unit around the target without triggering its movement Reactions.
Deal +1 weapon Damage if no other enemy is adjacent to you.

rider.title: Combo - Opener
rider.html: After a hit, gain 1 additional Combo if you attacked from a different space than on your previous Prowess Action.
